name: Shareable Win
tagline: A product-composed representation of a recorded accomplishment, built for a reader outside the product, with at least one route offered for sending it out.
desc: A shareable win packages a record the product already holds about the user, a level reached, a streak kept, a total accumulated, into a form a stranger could read on its own, then offers a route for sending it out. The question that decides whether a control belongs here is what the representation is about: an export or share control on a finished design distributes the user's own work, while a card stating how many designs the user made this year distributes the product's record of the user. The underlying accomplishment can come from an achievement, a streak, a rank, or another record the product tracks; this entry covers only the packaging and the route out, not the record itself.
principle: A record becomes evidence once someone who wasn't there can read it. Packaging what the product already holds turns a private state into something worth showing someone else.
warn: The design risk sits in the separating question itself, not in execution: a share, export, or download control placed on the user's own work is not this mechanic, and reading it as one points design attention at a growth surface that was never built. Confirm the representation's subject is a record the product holds about the user before treating a share icon as this mechanic operating.
variants: Verified win, carries an identifier or link a third party can check against the product
Recap win, composes a period's accumulated records into one summary rather than a single attained state
Shared-holder win, the underlying record belongs to a pair, team, or community rather than one person
Gated win, the representation or its sending route is held behind a purchase, plan, or eligibility condition
lifecycle: Needs an accomplishment already recorded before there's anything to package, so it has nothing to offer immediately after signup. Most valuable once the user has reached a result, a streak, or a total worth showing someone outside the product.
